_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Monday W17 opens with a compute-policy doubleheader. (1) Anthropic + Amazon expand to up to 5GW of AWS compute — Anthropic commits $100B+ over 10 years to AWS silicon (Trainium2/3/4 plus tens of millions of Graviton cores), Amazon adds $5B fresh equity at $350B pre-money with up to $20B more in milestone-tied tranches; nearly 1GW of Trainium2/3 capacity targeted online by end-2026. The deepest single-vendor multi-cloud commitment any frontier lab has made and the supply-side answer to two months of 'infinite Claude demand' signalling. (2) Marvell co-developing two Google AI chips — a memory processing unit (MPU) plus a new inference TPU — Marvell stock +6% to $147.84 on a ~2M-MPU pilot target; Broadcom drops as Google diversifies away from Broadcom (training TPUs) and MediaTek (Zebrafish inference). MPU concept reshapes the memory-bandwidth conversation that has dogged AI inference economics. (3) Foreign Policy op-ed 'Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview changes the cyber calculus' — flagship-venue legitimisation of the gated-frontier playbook just as the EU AI Act trilogue + GP-AI Code of Practice motion move into a decisive phase. (4) SiliconANGLE pre-positions Google Cloud Next '26 — 'the real story isn't AI, it's the control plane' — Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (rebrand of Vertex AI), 8th-gen TPUs split into 8t/Sunfish-Broadcom (training) + 8i/Zebrafish-MediaTek (inference), Workspace agent integrations as headline themes ahead of Pichai's Wed keynote. (5) Open-weights cross-current: Kimi K2.6 lands on OpenRouter ($0.60/$2.50 per 1M, trillion-param MoE, 12-hour autonomous coding stamina) — Willison ships llm-openrouter 0.6 with a refresh command same day; Ewan Mak posts an '88% coding cost savings vs Opus 4.7' review by end-of-day. Best long-form blog: Willison Claude Token Counter quantifies Anthropic's 'Opus 4.7 uses 1.0–1.35x more tokens' claim — 1.46x on Opus 4.7's own system prompt vs 4.6, 1.08x on a 30-page PDF; same per-token pricing means ~40% effective price bump for text-heavy workloads. Research (Monday cohort): GTA-2 atomic-to-open-ended tool-agent benchmark, Amazing Agent Race diagnoses strong tool use / weak navigation, Mind DeepResearch technical report, output-diversity-collapse stage localisation, early-pruning parallel-reasoning trajectories, Qwen3.5-Omni technical report, 1D ordered tokens for efficient test-time search. STAGE MOVES: compute-economics-thesis → consolidating (Anthropic $100B AWS pledge + 5GW unlock quantify the 'infinite demand' arc).
